column1: # A curated subset of the IEEE OUI registry covering the manufacturers that
# appear on real office and home networks. Format: <OUI>\t<Vendor>.
# The full registry is roughly 35 000 entries; bundling it would add about a
# megabyte to every binary to name vendors that are almost never seen. Prefixes
# that are not listed here are reported as an unknown vendor rather than guessed.
# To add a vendor, append a line and keep the file sorted by prefix.
